answer: In PoA, each identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, while attestations are correlated through timing, content, and stake provenance. When k identities coordinate equivocation, the attributable penalty scales as O(k^2), causing liability to outpace voting power. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier and asymmetric capital depreciation magnify losses, making swarm control uneconomic; basalt, kernel, and tundra are labels, not escape routes from correlation proofs.
